plot_training_logs: plot training and test results for specified fields from Deformable DETR training log files
plot_logs_mAP: plot mAP results from COCO evaluation logs with exponential weighted smoothing across multiple experiments
plot_logs_loss: plot loss_bbox_unscaled and class_error from training logs with solid training and dashed test lines

plot_precision_recall_exp_id: plot precision recall curves using experiment ID naming scheme from torch saved evaluation data files
